plannedSources.conditions: The Hardened Sand Wall , Hardened Ebonsand Wall , Hardened Crimsand Wall , and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Hardened Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Hardened Sand Walls may further spread conversion; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Hardened Sand Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.
